Class AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.r2dbc.connection.lookup.AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConnectionFactory, InitializingBean
public abstract class AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory extends Object implements ConnectionFactory, InitializingBean
Abstract ConnectionFactory implementation that routes create() calls to one of various target factories based on a lookup key. The latter is typically (but not necessarily) determined from some subscriber context.

允许配置默认目标 ConnectionFactory 作为回退。

对 `getMetadata()` 的调用如果已配置，则路由到`default ConnectionFactory`。

Since:
5.3
Author:
Mark Paluch，Jens Schauder

  • Method Details

    • setTargetConnectionFactories

      public void setTargetConnectionFactories(Map<?,?> targetConnectionFactories)
      Specify the map of target ConnectionFactories, with the lookup key as key. The mapped value can either be a corresponding ConnectionFactory instance or a connection factory name String (to be resolved via a ConnectionFactoryLookup).

      键可以是任意类型；该类仅实现通用的查找过程。具体的键表示将由resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object)和determineCurrentLookupKey()处理。

    • setDefaultTargetConnectionFactory

      public void setDefaultTargetConnectionFactory(Object defaultTargetConnectionFactory)
      Specify the default target ConnectionFactory, if any.

      映射值可以是相应的 ConnectionFactory 实例，或是一个连接工厂名称 String（将通过 ConnectionFactoryLookup 进行解析）。

      如果没有任何一个带键的 targetConnectionFactories 匹配 current lookup key，则使用此 ConnectionFactory 作为目标。

    • setLenientFallback

      public void setLenientFallback(boolean lenientFallback)
      Specify whether to apply a lenient fallback to the default ConnectionFactory if no specific ConnectionFactory could be found for the current lookup key.

      默认为 `true`，接受目标 ConnectionFactory 映射中无对应条目的查找键——在这种情况下，直接回退到该 ConnectionFactory 的默认值。

      将此标志切换为 `false`，如果您希望回退仅在未发出查找键时应用。没有 ConnectionFactory 条目的查找键将导致出现 IllegalStateException。

      See Also:

    • resolveSpecifiedLookupKey

      protected Object resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object lookupKey)
      Resolve the given lookup key object, as specified in the targetConnectionFactories map, into the actual lookup key to be used for matching with the current lookup key.

      默认实现直接返回给定的键。

      Parameters:
      lookupKey - 由用户指定的查找键对象
      Returns:
      根据匹配需要查找键。

    • resolveSpecifiedConnectionFactory

      protected ConnectionFactory resolveSpecifiedConnectionFactory(Object connectionFactory) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Resolve the specified connection factory object into a ConnectionFactory instance.

      默认实现处理 `ConnectionFactory` 实例和连接工厂名称（通过 ConnectionFactoryLookup 解析）。

      Parameters:
      `connectionFactory` - 在 targetConnectionFactories 映射中指定的连接工厂值对象
      Returns:
      解析后的ConnectionFactory（永远不会为null）
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - 在遇到不支持的值类型时

    • determineCurrentLookupKey

      protected abstract reactor.core.publisher.Mono<Object> determineCurrentLookupKey()
      确定当前的查找键。这通常通过检查订户上下文来实现，并允许使用任意键。返回的键必须与由 `resolveSpecifiedLookupKey(Object)` 方法解析的存储查找键类型匹配。
      Returns:
